channel.title: ShopNow Kitchen
channel.description: Air fryers and meat thermometers, read from official listings. Conflicts printed, prices never quoted.

item.title: Basket or oven-style air fryer: what should you compare?
item.description: Drawer versus door affects access, placement, and how you load food. Measure before comparing features.

item.title: A no-hype checklist for comparing air fryer capacity
item.description: A capacity label describes volume, not a serving count. Check the usable shape and the food you make.

item.title: How to assess cleanup and counter-space trade-offs
item.description: Dishwasher-safe applies to named parts. Read the care instructions and plan where they will dry.

item.title: Questions to ask before buying a multi-function kitchen appliance
item.description: A long feature list is useful only if it matches tasks you do. Which three would you use?

item.title: Instant-read or wireless thermometer: which do you actually need?
item.description: Compare a quick spot check with a leave-in monitoring workflow, subject to each model's instructions.

item.title: How to assess thermometer accuracy claims
item.description: Separate a seller-stated accuracy tolerance from a test report, calibration procedure, and certification document.

item.title: Air fryer at Thanksgiving: what actually fits
item.description: Use the listed fit examples as checks for a particular meal; do not extrapolate them to other foods.

item.title: Air fryer for a small kitchen: the three measurements that decide it
item.description: Measure depth, access, and the storage spot before comparing features.
